messages:
sara_sales: Uploaded the ACME pen-test bundle to the secure share. Need to confirm what we can send to them and the timeline for fixes. Link: https://redwood-secure.example/attachments/acme-pt-1987643210 :paperclip:
ops_bot: Files uploaded to bucket: s3://redwood-secure/acme/1987643210/ (read-only link generated) :package:
  - manifest: acme-pt-manifest.json
  - raw-report: acme-pt-raw.pdf
  - repro-scripts: exploits.tar.gz
  - checksums: acme-1987643210.sha256
jess_se: thanks — can we redact internal IPs and any customer PII before we hand the bundle to ACME? they asked for scan artifacts but legal flagged PII risk.
alex_eng: we'll redact IPs. recommend we replace repro-scripts with sanitized PoCs that don't include creds or internal hostnames. I can run a quick scrub script today.
mike_ciso: +1 on redaction. Also need CVSS and exploitability notes for each finding so ACME can triage. Sara, do we have an agreed remediation SLA with their security team?
sara_sales: not signed yet. They asked for a 30-day remediation window but security asked for prioritization guidance. We should propose 14 days for criticals, 30 for high, 60 for medium.
laura_pm: FYI product can ship a config toggle that mitigates the high risk (rate-limiting) — engineering estimates ~5 business days for a rollout to prod if we prioritize.
alex_eng: confirm we can push a hotfix to the auth microservice. ETA 4 business days if no regressions. For the exploitable RCE, we'll need a small patch + integration tests.
mike_ciso: Can we get a one-page risk acceptance template? ACME often requires our PO to sign off on mitigation plan + interim controls.
jess_se: I have a standard RA (risk acceptance) template. I'll attach the sanitized copy once redaction is done. Also clarifying: do we send the raw-report or a summary + artifacts? sales prefers full artifacts for trust but sec prefers summary.
sara_sales: customer explicitly asked for raw artifacts to validate findings. We need legal + sec ok. Mike, can you sign off on sanitized artifact delivery and a proposed timeline to share with them?
mike_ciso: I'll review. Tentative: share sanitized artifacts (no creds/PII/internal netblocks) by EOD Fri (1987680000), include manifest + CVSS details. Send raw repro steps only in obfuscated form. If they need raw PoCs, we require an NDA addendum + controlled access.
ops_bot: Checksum file acme-1987643210.sha256:
  3f8a9c1b2d...  acme-pt-raw.pdf
  7b2d4e5f6a...  exploits.tar.gz
  a1b2c3d4e5...  acme-pt-manifest.json
jess_se: posted scrub script here: `scripts/scrub_internal_ip.sh` — run with `./scrub_internal_ip.sh exploits.tar.gz > exploits-sanitized.tar.gz`
alex_eng: ran scrub, replaced internal hosts with placeholders, removed credential files. Verified checksums. I'll push sanitized bundle to s3://redwood-secure/acme/1987643210/sanitized/ and update manifest.
sara_sales: great. Once Mike signs, I'll send ACME the sanitized bundle + remediation timeline proposal. Also need to confirm whether they want weekly status updates.
laura_pm: agree on weekly status emails. Product will provide a short runbook for the mitigation steps and rollback notes.
mike_ciso: I reviewed the sanitized bundle. OK to share under the following conditions: 1) NDA addendum requested if they require binaries/unscrubbed PoCs; 2) remediation SLA proposal in writing; 3) designate a security contact for escalation. I can sign the sanitized release now.
sara_sales: approving draft email to ACME: "Attached: sanitized pen-test artifacts, manifest, CVSS + remediation timeline. Next steps: confirm acceptance of SLA and whether they need raw PoCs under NDA." Want me to send it or should solutions eng send?
jess_se: I'll send — include the runbook and the scrubbed PoC notes so they can reproduce safely. I'll cc mike_ciso and laura_pm.
ops_bot: audit log: sanitized bundle published by alex_eng at 1987681200. Access link expires in 30 days.
alex_eng: opened ticket SE-4821 to track fixes, assigned to eng-team-auth. ETA for criticals: 4 business days. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-4821
sara_sales: ACME security rep asked for an exact date. Based on the above, propose: sanitized artifacts today, initial mitigation deploy by 1987720000 (in ~2 business days), full patch rollout by 1987800000. I'll put those dates in the email.
mike_ciso: fine. Also added note: if ACME declines the NDA addendum but insists on raw PoCs, escalate to legal; do not send raw artifacts.
laura_pm: logging this for postmortem and improvements to the standard delivery checklist. We should add an automated scrub step to the intake pipeline.
sara_sales: thanks everyone. I'll send the email after Jess finalizes content. :thumbsup:
jess_se: sending now. short copy and attachments uploaded. ping me if ACME requests direct access to the raw bucket — we'll route through legal.
ops_bot: message posted to audit channel: sanitized bundle shared with acme@acme-corp.com (pending acceptance).
